extraction.note: Independent of docker/runners/fpocket/normalize_results.py: every observable is re-derived from the raw fpocket tree with this script's own parsing, so a production-parser error cannot make the reference agree.

reference_case.ligand_contact_rule: Every pocket whose contacted-atom file contains a HETATM line is recorded in expected.ligand_contacting_pockets. The bound HEM/CPZ sit in the substrate pocket, so the leading pocket contacts them.
reference_case.title: Structure of mammalian cytochrome P450 2B4 with bound 4-(4-chlorophenyl)imidazole
